Spouses.bio:
[[Category:Antwerp Cemetery, Dimboola, Victoria]]
== Biography ==
Mary Bridget (called Bridget) was born about 1847 to Patrick Curley and Bridget (Curley) Stanton, in Ireland.

Bridget married David Matthew in 1883 in Victoria.<ref>Victoria Births, Deaths, and Marriages. Marriage. Reg No. 2417 / 1883. CURLEY, Bridget, to MATTHEW, David.</ref>

After her marriage, Bridget and David resided at 'Tycooley' in Antwerp, Victoria.<ref>1927 'Family Notices', Advocate (Melbourne, Vic. : 1868 - 1954), 7 April, p. 17. , viewed 05 Apr 2026, http://nla.gov.au/nla.news-article171638075</ref><ref>1927 'Family Notices', The Age (Melbourne, Vic. : 1854 - 1954), 2 April, p. 5. , viewed 05 Apr 2026, http://nla.gov.au/nla.news-article205818789</ref>

Bridget passed away on the 16th of March 1927 in Antwerp, Victoria, Australia.<ref>Victoria Births, Deaths, and Marriages. Death. Reg No. 1957/1927. Matthews, Bridget Mary. Place of Event: Jeparit. Mother's Name: Mary Stanton. Father's Name: Patrick Curley. Age at Death: 80.</ref><ref>1927 'Advertising', The Age (Melbourne, Vic. : 1854 - 1954), 30 November, p. 7. , viewed 05 Apr 2026, http://nla.gov.au/nla.news-article202289695</ref> She was buried in the Antwerp Cemetery.<ref>FindAGrave Memorial ID: 228297745.</ref>

Name: Glasgow-4095
bio:
[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
{{Estimated Date|Birth}}

== Biography ==

'''Marion Glasgow''' was a daughter of [[Glasgow-3163|Andrew Glasgow of uncertain Corsoun]]. Andrew's testament, made on 6 February 1597/8, provides that if his wife Elizat Stevinsoun was not pregnant, his third was to be divided among “his said sone and his said [dochter… struck through] Marione, Jonet, Isobell.”<ref name="Andrew1598">National Records of Scotland, Edinburgh Commissary Court, CC8/8/32, images 123–124, testament testamentar and inventory of Andro Glasgw, made 6 February 1597/8, death stated as 7 February, confirmed 10 July 1598; corrected working transcription of the original register images. Printed index: Scottish Record Society, ''Commissariot of Edinburgh: Register of Testaments, 1514–1600'', [https://archive.org/details/scottishrecordso01scotuoft/page/n117/mode/1up p. 108].</ref>

Her brother [[Glasgow-4006|Robert]] is expressly called Andrew's son by Elizat. The testament does not separately state that Elizat was this daughter's mother, so maternity should not be inferred as certain from this clause alone.<ref name="Andrew1598"/>

== Research Notes ==

=== Identity ===

Named as a lawful daughter in Andrew's 1598 testament. No later record has been securely connected to her; the same-name Glasgow women of the period have no Corsoun, Stevenson, sibling or succession bridge to this household, so none is attached here.

A separate [[Glasgow-3062|Marion Glasgow]] is identified as [[Glasgow-3188|Ninian Glasgow]]'s sister in his 1613 testament and as the mother of James Fultoun in a 1610 Glasgow baptism. Neither record names Andrew, Elizat or Corsoun. This is a same-name identity comparison, not a proved match; keep the profiles separate pending a connecting record.<ref>National Records of Scotland, Glasgow Commissary Court, CC9/7/9, images 142–145, Ninian Glasgow testament; Glasgow & West of Scotland Family History Society, [https://www.gwsfhs.org.uk/records/james-fultoun/ James Fultoun baptism index], 7 August 1610.</ref>
